description.name: Entry
description.text:
7 single-target Fire/Ice/Water/NE ranged physical attacks at Cap Break Level 1, ATK/MND +25% & DEF/RES +30% to party, Cap Break Level 1, Dual Awoken Sharpshooter Mode I & Sharpshooter Damage +5% to user
Dual Awoken Sharpshooter Mode I: Sharpshooter Ability Boost, Triplecast Sharpshooter & Quick Sharpshooter

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text:
Instant ATB 1, Tri-Element Mode II & Dual Awoken Sharpshooter Mode II to user
Dual Awoken Sharpshooter Mode II: Sharpshooter Ability Boost, Instant Sharpshooter & chases a Sharpshooter ability with Sharpshooter Damage +30% for 2 turns and ATB 100/200/999% 2 to user with at least 0/3/4 Sharpshooters in party
Tri-Element Mode II: En-Fire Stack, En-Ice Stack or En-Water Stack
